The text provided contains a clear internal inconsistency. In the first sentence, Bob states that he has been an only child all his life. However, in the second sentence, he discusses having a brother who is a lawyer. These two statements are mutually exclusive; one cannot be an only child and also have a brother. Therefore, the narrative lacks logical consistency because the second event directly contradicts the premise established in the first.

The season that comes after autumn is winter.
